listing.name: Super Mario World / snesrev smw
listing.summary: Use an upstream-prepared Super Mario World / snesrev smw player with matching originals; runtime maintenance and player data stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Keep the matching original
steps.instruction: Use your own unchanged USA Super Mario World original. The selected upstream runtime requires a 524288-byte unheadered smw.sfc for its matching packaged smw_assets.bps; BPS validation can reject a different original. Preserve the original unchanged outside the player folder. Super Mario All-Stars, translations, patched files and other editions are different inputs.

steps.title: Finish upstream setup and select the real player
steps.instruction: Use the upstream v0.1 Windows package in a separate writable folder with its matching smw_assets.bps, smw.ini and SDL2.dll; place only your matching original copy named smw.sfc beside smw.exe. Alternatively finish the upstream-supported source build and matching smw_assets.dat extraction. Finish normal upstream setup successfully before registration; do not select extract_assets.bat, run_with_tcc.bat or another compiler/helper as the player. Use the selected player’s containing folder as working directory and keep the already working literal arguments; do not invent shell commands.

steps.title: Preserve the actual runtime and player data
steps.instruction: Preserve the complete working player folder, smw.ini and saves tree, including title-specific SRAM, backup, snapshots, playthrough and mismatch evidence. Keep the creating runtime with every existing state. The upstream RAM comparison and replay features do not prove compatibility between builds or with another SNES runtime; do not transplant retained state.

steps.title: Register the existing player and use explicit Play
steps.instruction: You and upstream own this external runtime and all original/game/player data. Registration binds your explicitly selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; it does not authenticate a curated immutable package or original. Play requires your explicit intent. Removing the Portcove registration preserves every external file. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and external deletion are unavailable. Finish upstream setup yourself and register only the existing working player; no successful setup, gameplay or state compatibility is claimed by this guide.

warnings: This upstream setup / existing-player guide uses explicit user-selected registration and Play. It does not qualify managed packages, original-file authenticity, gameplay or state compatibility.

New managed ROM extraction/build and retained state compatibility remain #136 scope. This guide offers the existing prepared player only, without admitting arbitrary ROMs or creating a per-title extraction substitute.
